summary: This video showcases an updated Toxin team performance in the Crown Contest against the Fire Guardians (Lava Balor / Elemental Guardian - Fire). The lineup scores over 3.86 billion damage in a 5-minute encounter. Specific stat thresholds and gear build guidelines are detailed for all five heroes.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.verdict: Main DPS for Toxin Crown Contest team
heroes.note: Build with full Enlightenment and Attack to maximize damage.

heroes.name: Sleight
heroes.note: Build with as much Attack as possible.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Focus on high Accuracy to apply debuffs reliably.

heroes.name: Oggok
heroes.note: Build full Resistance and take the talent that shares Resistance to the team.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Equipped with the Puppeteer artifact/set for team support.

teams.note: Deals 3.86B damage to Lv 240 Elemental Guardian - Fire by maintaining high Resistance across all heroes.

tips: Ensure every hero in the team has at least 250 Resistance for the strategy to work.
Build Serpentemis focusing on Enlightenment and Attack as the primary damage dealer.
Equip Oggok with full Resistance and use the talent that shares Resistance with allies.
title: Toxin Team (UPDATED) vs Fire Guardians | Crown Contest | Dragonheir | Season 8
